provider_inputs: evidence-grounded learned buyer-type summaries built with held-out-product transactions excluded
100-product catalog with product descriptions and candidate low/mid/high prices
elicitation_target: relative product preference at reference price plus price penalty; not purchase probability
known_limitation: The provider is the assistant in the same broader conversation that has discussed prior H&M experiments. The scoring panel itself was generated without opening split labels or sales outcomes after the blinded panel was frozen, but it is not equivalent to independent isolated API calls.
